clips.send: A home seller sends this to a friend about to list their house: anger at realizing their own Realtor's lazy photos may be quietly costing them thousands.
clips.caption:
Comment MONEY and I'll send you Kevin's free audios.

Kevin Trudeau says he scrolls Zillow and Realtor.com and sees the same mistake on almost every listing: a phone snapshot with no eye for the room, and a description nobody bothered to write well.

Most people have no idea how to position a product - or a house - so it actually pulls someone in. It isn't luck. It's a skill almost nobody learns.

Fix just those two things, Kevin says, and the same house pulls two to three times the interest - every time.

The seller never finds out their listing was the problem. They just blame the market.

What's one photo in your own listing that's quietly costing you money?
